titleInfo.title: Distant force
titleInfo.subTitle: a memoir of the Teledyne Corporation and the man who created it, with an introduction to Teledyne Technologies

physicalDescription.extent: vii, 316 p., [8] p. of plates : col. ill. ; 24 cm. + 1 CD-ROM (4 3/4 in.)

abstract.#text: [The] CD contains articles from the Teledyne quarterly and annual reports from 1969 through 1995. These articles were written by Robert J. McVicker, Teledyne's staff writer ... They reflect Teledyne's participation in various emerging ... technologies with new products and as a resource to many government research and development programs. The articles are in PDF formatted files. A directory of all reports, which have been indexed by date, title and Teledyne company featured, is in a PDF file on this disk and also included in the Appendix of the book [p.295-303] ... To find a specific issue ..., open the directory file and click on the issue or title or Teledyne company name. - Publisher.

tableOfContents.#text: Distant Force A Memoir of the Teledyne Corporation and the Man Who Created It -- Singleton the Man -- The Beginnings -- The Early Acquisitions -- Our Second Decade: Growth Without Major Aquisitions -- The Roller-Coaster '70s -- Beginning Our Third Decade -- Our Fourth Decade Begins -- Continued Operational Progress in 1990 -- A Teledyne Renaissance -- Teledyne Technologies, Incorporated by Robert Mehabrian -- Henry Singleton - Rancher -- Henry Earl Singleton, 1916-1999 -- Eulogy delivered at All Saints Church, Beverly Hills, California on September 8, 1999 By Dr. George A. Roberts.

note.#text: by George A. Roberts, with Robert J. McVicker.

note: "This CD contains articles from the quarterly and annual reports conveying Teledyne's participation in various emerging and significant technologies. The articles are in PDF formatted files. A directory of all reports and annuals indexed by date, time, and Teledyne company featured, is included on the disk"--CD ROM label.

physicalLocation.#text: Baker Library, Harvard Business School, Harvard University
